title: DemRun
description: Catalog row dem-run 1.1.0: the discrete element method with particle-replacement breakage on the laboratory jaw crusher of Barrios et al. 2020 at the three operating points that have a measured throughput, net power and product, beside the measurement and the prediction of the product's population-balance engine with a laboratory preset, with the verdicts against bands set before the runs. Written by data-pipeline/pipeline/stages/dem.py to data/derived/dem/jaw-lab.json from runs of the pinned package crushdem. A function of the package version, the seed and the committed inputs: it holds no wall time and no date.

basis.description: Why a verdict is not compared: run_incomplete (the particle run did not run the whole batch through, so no verdict rests on it), no_window (the run gives no steady window), no_work_index (no work index of the ore is published, so the population balance predicts no power), nothing_passed (the run discharged nothing); null for met and not met.

resolved.description: For a verdict that rests on a steady window of the particle simulation: true when the nearer band edge lies more than two standard errors from the window mean (the package's rule); null when the verdict rests on no window statistic.
